scenes.headline: Bet your friend can't beat you.
scenes.voiceover: Think you're faster than your friends? Prove it.

scenes.headline: 20 push-ups. First done wins.
scenes.voiceover: Fire a challenge at a friend. Push-ups, a plank, a run. First one done wins.

scenes.headline: Win the dare, earn the scroll.
scenes.voiceover: The winner walks away with screen time minutes, earned the fun way.

scenes.headline: Lose? Your feeds stay locked.
scenes.voiceover: Lose, and your apps stay locked until you earn your way back in.

scenes.headline: Earn your scroll. Together.
scenes.voiceover: Drift. Challenge your friends. Earn your scroll.
